author: Linnaeus, 1758

months.note: 알은 3월에 낳아 27일쯤 품고, 새끼는 깨어난 뒤 30일쯤 지나 둥지를 떠난다.

summary: 평지와 산지의 침엽수림, 활엽수림, 혼효림에서 홀로 지내며 전국에 산다. 낮에는 나뭇가지에 앉아 꼼짝하지 않다가 밤에 움직이는데, 소리를 듣고 먹이를 잡으므로 비가 오거나 바람이 센 날에는 낮에도 사냥한다. 날개에 솜털이 많아 날 때 소리가 나지 않는다. 까마귀나 매가 쓰던 둥지, 나무 구멍 등에 3월에 흰 알 4개를 3~5일 간격으로 낳으며, 국외에서는 독일, 영국, 이탈리아, 오스트리아, 일본, 중국, 몽골 등에 분포한다.

points.en: back and belly streaked with cross-bars

sexes.text: 암수 생김새가 같고 암컷이 조금 크다.

young: 둥지를 떠날 무렵의 어린새는 몸깃이 솜털처럼 성기고, 머리와 몸에 흰빛이 도는 가는 가로무늬가 있어 어른새보다 희끗하게 보인다. 첫겨울에는 어른새와 거의 같아진다.

art.subject: Tawny Owl (Strix aluco), adult (sexes alike), as seen in Korean forests all year (the East Asian population, often split as Himalayan Owl Strix nivicolum): plumage grey-brown; rounded facial disc greyish with fine concentric lines and a narrow dark rim, a whitish V of eyebrows between the eyes; crown and upperparts grey-brown with dark streaks and fine vermiculations, a row of whitish spots along the scapulars and on the wing coverts; underparts pale greyish-buff with bold dark vertical streaks crossed by fine horizontal bars. Bill pale yellowish-horn, partly hidden in feathers; eyes large and blackish-brown; legs and toes feathered pale buff.
art.pose: perched motionless on a branch close to the trunk by day
art.scene: Korean mixed conifer and broadleaf forest; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, front view perched: round head without ear tufts, grey facial disc with a whitish V between the large blackish eyes, pale bill, underparts with dark streaks crossed by fine bars
adult, side view perched: compact rounded body, grey-brown upperparts with dark streaks and a row of whitish scapular spots, short tail
art.build: Medium-sized, stocky owl, 37–39cm, larger than a feral pigeon and smaller than a crow, with a large, rounded head without ear tufts and a short neck. Bill short and strongly hooked. Wings broad and rounded; tail short. Sits upright and compact, often close to the trunk. In flight broad round wings and a big head; flight silent.
avoid: Do not give it ear tufts.
Do not paint yellow or orange eyes; the eyes are blackish.
Do not paint the long tail, plain pale face and yellow bill of Ural Owl (Strix uralensis).
Do not paint the bird bright rufous-brown; paint it grey-brown.
